meta.note: Seed catalog. Once the CJ_API_KEY repo secret is set, the refresh-catalog workflow replaces this file with live CJdropshipping products.

products.name: Insulated Steel Bottle · 750ml
products.description: Double-walled stainless steel keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12. Powder-coated matte finish, leak-proof cap, and a mouth wide enough for ice cubes. Fits standard bottle cages and car cup holders.

products.name: Studio Yoga Mat · Natural Rubber
products.description: A 4.5mm natural rubber mat with a grippy polyurethane top layer that holds through sweaty sessions. Dense enough to protect knees and wrists, firm enough for balance work. Includes a cotton carry strap.

products.name: Yoga Essentials Set · Mat, Block & Towel
products.description: Everything for a home practice in one box: a 6mm cushioned mat, a high-density foam block, a microfiber towel, and a pair of 1kg hand weights. A considered starter kit — or a complete refresh.

products.name: Home Strength Kit · Dumbbells & Band
products.description: A pair of 5kg rubber-coated dumbbells and a heavy resistance band with padded handles. Covers presses, rows, curls, and full-body circuits without a rack — the compact home gym that actually gets used.

products.name: Neoprene Hand Weights · Pair
products.description: Soft-grip neoprene dumbbells in 2kg and 3kg pairs. Non-slip, non-marking, and flat-edged so they don't roll away mid-set. Ideal for pilates, barre, and high-rep conditioning.

products.name: Cast-Iron Kettlebell · 12kg
products.description: Single-cast iron with a smooth, wide handle for two-handed swings and a flat base for renegade rows. Color-coded weight band and a rust-resistant matte coating. The one piece of kit that covers strength and conditioning alike.

products.name: Non-Slip Exercise Mat · 8mm
products.description: An 8mm high-density mat built for floor work: sit-ups, planks, stretching, and bodyweight circuits. Textured on both sides so it stays put on hardwood, with sealed edges that won't peel.

products.name: Grip Pro Hot Yoga Mat
products.description: Made for heat: an absorbent suede-feel top layer that grips harder the more you sweat, bonded to a natural rubber base. Machine-washable and free of PVC and silicone.

products.name: Seamless Training Bra
products.description: Medium-support racerback in a seamless knit that moves with you. Sweat-wicking, quick-drying, and cut to stay put through inversions and intervals. Sizes XS–XL.

products.name: Olympic Barbell · 20kg
products.description: A 20kg, 2.2m bar with dual knurl marks, smooth-spinning bushings, and a 190k PSI shaft that flexes where it should and nowhere else. Standard 50mm sleeves fit any Olympic plates.
